body:
M7.P4 audit #383 found a script/UI reason mismatch while verifying #356. A present unsupported/future layout marker is safely refused, but the installed scan page says COULDN’T FIND YOUR CLOUD FOLDER. The accurate version explanation is discarded.

Primary evidence: replacement09 cloud-ui08 `UI26-future-script.log`, `UI26-future-interface.log` and `01-UI26-future-refusal.png`; these installed cloud/ES bytes are unchanged through replacement14. `cloud_migrate_layout:970–995` detects unsupported/malformed marker and returns application status4. `cloud_scan:153–176` suppresses its output, and `why_for_rc:97–104` maps4 to rclone directory absence. No write or preservation failure is claimed.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes, with the existing synthetic local WebDAV marker fixture. No handheld or personal cloud is involved.

Already written: data, pointers and marker remain intact, but the misleading outcome may prompt unnecessary folder setup. Repair the reason contract without weakening refusal or introducing writes.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Future/malformed marker refusal reaches the scan/boot/transfer UI with an accurate supported reason, with retained old/new installed frame and script-output proof; no false missing-folder diagnosis.
- [ ] Real missing-folder, provider/network failure and pending-migration controls keep their correct reasons; enumerate other application-status mappings that currently pass through the rclone-only mapper.
- [ ] Unsupported markers, cloud bytes and all pointers remain identical; named host tests and rebuilt installed VM/UI controls pass, including French strings where changed.

Primary criterion I356-L76 is PARTIAL until resolved. This is one audit finding, not the completed punch list or a completed audit.


### Candidate15 French frame gap — 2026-10-06 21:44 UTC

The installed EN/FR future/malformed/config/record commands emit their correct distinct reasons and preserve state. Direct640px UI04 review finds the French settings-read line truncated at `SYNCHR...`. This remains part of PL-005, not a new punch item. Frame: `cloud-ui04-progress-review/frames/01-fr_FR-reason-config-opening-result.png` under the candidate15 QA directory (retained locally, next evidence publication pending).

- [ ] The rebuilt640px EN/FR failure pages and timeout/recovery cards show their complete meaningful reason, including settings-read failure, with unchanged refusal/preservation behavior and directly reviewed frames.
title: M7.P4: Preserve the reason for unsupported cloud-layout refusal
